1.web: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up, and brought me to the east gate of Yahweh’s house, which looks eastward: and see, at the door of the gate twenty-five men; and I saw in their midst Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
1.asv: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of Jehovah’s house, which looketh eastward: and behold, at the door of the gate five and twenty men; and I saw in the midst of them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

2.web: He said to me, Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity, and who give wicked counsel in this city;
2.asv: And he said unto me, Son of man, these are the men that devise iniquity, and that give wicked counsel in this city;

3.web: who say, The time is not near to build houses: this is the cauldron, and we are the meat.
3.asv: that say, The time is not near to build houses: this city is the caldron, and we are the flesh.

4.web: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, son of man.
4.asv: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.

5.web: The Spirit of Yahweh fell on me, and he said to me, Speak, Thus says Yahweh: Thus you have said, house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.
5.asv: And the Spirit of Jehovah fell upon me, and he said unto me, Speak, Thus saith Jehovah: Thus have ye said, O house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.

6.web: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.
6.asv: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.

7.web: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Your slain whom you have laid in its midst, they are the meat, and this is the cauldron; but you shall be brought out of its midst.
7.asv: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron; but ye shall be brought forth out of the midst of it.

8.web: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you, says the Lord Yahweh.
8.asv: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword upon you, saith the Lord Jehovah.

9.web: I will bring you out of its midst, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
9.asv: And I will bring you forth out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

10.web: You shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and you shall know that I am Yahweh.
10.asv: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

11.web: This shall not be your cauldron, neither shall you be the meat in its midst; I will judge you in the border of Israel;
11.asv: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; I will judge you in the border of Israel;

12.web: and you shall know that I am Yahweh: for you have not walked in my statutes, neither have you executed my ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.
12.asv: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither have ye executed mine ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are round about you.

13.web: When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”
13.asv: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord Jehovah! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?

14.web: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
14.asv: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

15.web: “Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your relatives, and all the house of Israel, all of them, to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far away from Yahweh. This land has been given to us for a possession.’”
15.asv: Son of man, thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from Jehovah; unto us is this land given for a possession.

16.web: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come.
16.asv: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they are come.

17.web: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.
17.asv: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.

18.web: They shall come there, and they shall take away all the detestable things of it and all its abominations from there.
18.asv: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.

19.web: I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh;
19.asv: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh;

20.web: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
20.asv: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.

21.web: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads, says the Lord Yahweh.
21.asv: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord Jehovah.

22.web: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
22.asv: Then did the cherubim lift up their wings, and the wheels were beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

23.web: Yahweh’s glory went up from the midst of the city, and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
23.asv: And the glory of Jehovah went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

24.web: The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
24.asv: And the Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

25.web: Then I spoke to them of the captivity all the things that Yahweh had shown me.
25.asv: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that Jehovah had showed me.
